question: If the angle of the sector with radius 7 cm is 120° then find the length of the arc (in cm). (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

If the angle of the sector with radius 7 cm is 120° 

**Formula Used:**

Length of sector = θ/360 × 2π r

**Calculation:**

 Length of sector = θ/360 × 2π r

⇒ (120/360) × 2 (22/7) 7

⇒ 44/3

**∴ The length of the sector (in cm) is 44/3 cm.**
